newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier to sell Nova Bus stake.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier to sell Nova Bus stake.

text.p: Bombardier Inc said on Wednesday that it planned to sell its stake in Nova Bus Corp, after an agreement among Nova Bus shareholders to find a buyer for the company.

In November 1994, Bombardier invested C$7.2 million to acquire 25 percent of the share capital of Nova Bus and C$8 million in a five-year debenture convertible to an additional 14 percent interest in the company.

The shareholders in Nova include the Fonds de solidarite des travailleurs du Quebec (FTQ), with a 39 percent stake, Bombardier (25 percent), Societe Innovatech du Grand Montreal (10 percent). Certain Nova managers own 26 percent.
Bombardier said it concluded that the integration of the management of Nova Bus manufacturing of urban transit buses with Bombardier's rolling stock would bring limited advantages.

Bombardier's investment in Nova Bus also did not meet its Transportation Group's strategic focus, which was more geared to expansion in South America and Asia and other areas outside its traditional markets in Europe, Bombardier said.
